The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the thirteenth season of {{aniseries|PTS}}, [[S13|Pokémon: DP Sinnoh League Victors]], in {{pmin|Australia}} and {{pmin|New Zealand}} ({{wp|DVD region code|DVD Region 4}}). ==Partial collections== {{incomplete|section|Disc divisions}} Two Sinnoh League Victors Collections were released by {{wp|Magna Pacific}} (now known as Beyond Home Entertainment) in 2011, containing the whole season between them. The DVDs don't include English closed captioning. ===Pokémon: DP Sinnoh League Victors - Collection 1=== [[File:DP SLV Collection 1.png|thumb|Pokémon: DP Sinnoh League Victors - Collection 1]] Pokémon: DP Sinnoh League Victors - Collection 1 was released by {{wp|Magna Pacific}} (now known as Beyond Home Entertainment) in Australia on June 1, 2011 and in New Zealand on June 16, 2011. It contains two discs with 17 episodes across them combined and uses a {{wp|4:3}} {{wp|aspect ratio}}. ''[[DP191|Memories are Made of Bliss!]]'' |} {{-}} ==Season 13 disc set== [[File:DP SLV Season 13.png|thumb|DigiPack cover art]] [[File:DP SLV Season 13 Repack.png|thumb|Slimline cover art]] {{wp|Magna Pacific}} (now known as Beyond Home Entertainment) began releasing DigiPack disc sets of each season in 2010. The Season 13 DigiPack disc set was released by {{wp|Magna Pacific}} (now known as Beyond Home Entertainment) in Australia on December 1, 2011 and in New Zealand on December 8, 2011. It contains four discs with 34 episodes across them combined and uses a {{wp|4:3}} {{wp|aspect ratio}}. Its catalogue number is DBX13832. Its discs are designed to resemble a [[Quick Ball]]. The DigiPack disc set was re-released exclusive to JB Hi-Fi online [https://www.facebook.com/BeyondHomeEntertainment/posts/980903292007738 on July 14, 2016] and in JB Hi-Fi stores [https://www.facebook.com/BeyondHomeEntertainment/posts/1034172803347453 on September 21, 2016] to celebrate the [[Pokémon 20th Anniversary]]. The DVDs do not include English closed captioning. This disc set was re-released by Beyond Home Entertainment in a slimline case in Australia on April 2, 2014 with a different cover and the catalogue number BHE5397. ===Contents=== Each disc features artwork of a specific Pokémon on the disc itself.
